# Feature: fake adapter contract fixture

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #33 -->

## Intent
A fake adapter supplies ordered, schema-valid samples plus Detect/Doctor/Launch/Collect so T-006 contract tests run in CI without a browser or network.

## Preconditions
- Adapter SDK manifest + harness (#32)
- Canonical sample schema (#4)

## Happy Path
- [ ] Fake adapter implements Detect, Doctor, Launch, and Collect at a minimal level
- [ ] Contract tests check sample ordering and schema-valid output
- [ ] Tests need no network
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Backpressure: extra samples are dropped and quality is degraded (not a fake pass)

## Regression
- [ ] Existing manifest harness still rejects unknown capabilities and schema major mismatch
- [ ] No Playwright

## Assumptions
- UI copy is English
- Fake adapter lives in `packages/adapter-sdk` (no new workspace package)
- Collect never writes files

## Security Coverage
- P-04: fake launch/collect write nothing; detect is read-only on a file-name list
- F-03: no tokens
- Out of scope: F-01, B-01, B-04, auth

## Implementation Notes
- `packages/adapter-sdk/src/fake.ts` implements Detect (marker file name), Doctor (injected node flag), Launch (pid 0, local kill), Collect (ordered `frame_time` samples).
- Overflow `count > maxBuffer` drops extras and sets `quality: "degraded"`.
- Contract tests parse samples with `parseSample`; no network, no Playwright.

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: one `collectFake` call → ordered samples (or drop+degraded). Detect/doctor/launch are single-hop in-memory.
- N-actors: 1 collect → N samples up to maxBuffer; extras dropped once, not re-emitted.
- Invalid: missing marker → unknown; missing node → doctor not ok.
- Two consumers: harness validates the same `FAKE_MANIFEST` the fake exports.
